description: CapMeta builder tool adding tools to a draft (no Linode API call). Pins the two refusals (an absent name and a name the registry does not hold) and the success path, which setup_calls reaches by creating the draft against the same server first. Exact tool names rather than a wildcard: a pinned wildcard expansion would move every time the surface grows.

cases.name: refuses a name no draft carries
adds the named tools and reports them sorted
